legend.0: 1 - Formatting, comments or docs only; no behaviour change.
legend.1: 2 - Trivial rename or refactor; behaviour clearly unchanged.
legend.2: 3 - Small local behaviour change that is easy to verify by reading.
legend.3: 4 - Local behaviour change with a few branches to check.
legend.4: 5 - Logic change that other code depends on, or a change to behaviour-guarding tests.
legend.5: 6 - Non-trivial logic change with edge cases that need executed tests.
legend.6: 7 - Change to error handling, diagnostics or code generation paths.
legend.7: 8 - Change to public API, serialization format or security-relevant handling.
legend.8: 9 - Change that can silently break wire compatibility or corrupt data.
legend.9: 10 - Change that can weaken security or corrupt data for all users.
